On behalf of the petitioner Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that no recovery has been effected from the petitioner pursuant to joining his investigation after receiving notice under Section 35(3) BNSS from the police officer and has already submitted all the relevant documents which were available with him relating to the present FIR.

On behalf of the State Learned State Counsel appearing on advance notice on instructions from SI Pardeep opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail but is not in a position to controvert the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner.

Nothing is cited for effecting recovery from the present petitioner for which his custodial interrogation can be sought.
